title: SC-11-10-02 Kept plan completes and waives the penalty, a late plan breaks
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given a payment plan
When instalments are paid on time or late
Then a kept plan completes and waives the penalty and a late plan breaks
